method: NAIVE. Written straight from the deposited text using only the writing-l4-rules skill. No pipeline, no coverage table, no probe record, no independent test pass, no human gate. One pass, no review.
edition_encoded: Road Traffic Act 1961 (Singapore), 2020 Revised Edition, informal consolidation, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/, incorporating the Road Traffic (Miscellaneous Amendments) Act 2025 (section 5 of which restructured ss 64 and 65).
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is reproduced under the standing grant in SSO's Terms of Use cl.13 - see ../../SOURCE-LICENSE.md

checks.command: l4 run rta-cases-driving-offences.l4 ; l4 run rta-cases-forfeiture-accidents.l4 ; l4 run rta-cases-speeding.l4 ; l4 run rta-cases-demerit-points.l4 ; l4 run rta-cases-seat.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: SCOPED from 447,000 characters to the driving offences most drivers can commit. rta-driving-offences.l4: s 35(3) (driving without a licence), ss 64 and 65 (dangerous and careless driving: harm tiers, repeat, serious and serious repeat offenders, minimum terms, mandatory disqualification), s 65B (phones), s 67 (drink-driving), s 67A(3) (specified offences for enhanced penalties). rta-forfeiture-accidents.l4: s 65AA (forfeiture of the vehicle) and s 84 (duties after an accident). Not encoded: Part 1 (vehicles), Part 1A, the rest of Part 2 including s 42 general disqualification, Part 3, s 63 (speeding) except as it feeds the repeat-offender test, ss 68 to 83, public service vehicles, parking, and the rules (including the prescribed alcohol limit). rta-speeding.l4 (added 11 October 2026 for REQ-0273): s 63 (speeding) with its punishment under the general penalty s 131(2), composition and its cap (s 135), s 139AA, speeding in ss 64(11)(b) and 67A(2), court disqualification (ss 42, 43(1)), the points and suspension machinery (ss 45 to 47A), new-driver revocation (s 35A) and s 81(1B); speed limits, composition sums, points and thresholds are inputs because they live in rules not deposited. rta-demerit-points.l4 (added 12 October 2026 for REQ-0273): the Road Traffic (Composition of Offences) Rules (R 29) rule 2 (s 63(4) is compoundable, and by whom; no sum is fixed) and the Road Traffic (Driver Improvement Points System) Rules (R 25) rules 3, 3A, 4, 5 and 7 with Schedule items (1) and (2) (the speeding bands: 25 km/h over is 8 points; suspension available at 24 points in 24 months, or 12 in 12 after an earlier suspension, for up to 36 months), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/RTA1961-R29.txt and RTA1961-R25.txt; the expressway speed limit, any composition scale and the new-driver revocation threshold (R 32) remain outside the deposit.
seat: the driver (or rider) of a motor vehicle on a Singapore road
